evidence: A new ALD chemistry is proposed using bis(1-dimethylamino-2-methyl-2-butoxy) nickel (II) [Ni(dmamb)2] and H2S as precursors. ... The deposition/growth process of the Ni3S2 consists of four reaction steps. First, the surface of the substrate is exposed to vapors of Ni(dmamb)2, resulting in surface adsorption in a self-limiting manner. Second, high-purity N2 gas is introduced to purge the residual molecules. Third, the surface is exposed to H2S to form a layer of product. Finally, high-purity N2 gas is introduced again to purge the residual H2S in the chamber.
